hook.name: ModularLaunchpadHook
hook.description: Modular Uniswap v4 launchpad hook with optional anti-snipe (time-based per-buy WETH cap curve), buy throttle (pool-wide rate limit during launch window), and JIT liquidity defense. Supports two fee models: standard (per-swap afterSwap take with optional creator-burn and liquidity-deepening redirects) or universal (hook-held seed LP with permissionless harvest() into a 70/30 creator/protocol split). This instance uses universal economics with anti-snipe enabled.
